# NafArro Solutions

> Kenya-based technology partner building business process automation, custom websites, web applications, and data analysis solutions for growing businesses worldwide.

NafArro Solutions ("King of Automation") helps small and mid-sized companies replace manual workflows with reliable software. We specialize in React, Node.js, TypeScript, and Supabase, and serve clients across East Africa and globally. Engagements start with a free consultation and are quoted by email — we do not display public pricing.
